senn: Buying, or warming your hands? Either. Don't block the counter.
If it bites you, bring the coin back with it. I'll still take the coin.
The closed box is a gamble. I don't look inside. That's the price.
lye: Sit. The book takes the points back. I don't haggle with it.
Gold turns the page. The bruises stay yours.
Runes are in the codex. Read them. I am not a tutor.
pell: Quill is the scout. Coin first. The lamp goes where they go.
If the lamp drops, don't dig a hole. A town can stand them up.
brin: Nets, oil, cord. The bench still works. The water does not.
On the flats you will see two of you. Swing at the one who is late.
Morra answers a struck bell. I am not interested in meeting her.
lute: The living go in one book. The drowned go in the other. You can guess which is thicker.
I can unpick a bad set of skills. The mere keeps the gold. So do I.
nim: Quill knows which reed is a lurker. Coin, then the road.
Bring them back breathing or not. I can get the lamp lit again.
vetch: Steel on the left. Fruit on the right. Only one of those is for eating.
Still here at dusk? Then the rows will do the shopping.
Gamble if you like. I like the gold. We don't have to share a reason.
sile: The king was a tree before I had shelves. I keep the pages that still mean something.
I can unwind a build. The roots will not thank you. The coin will.
hest: You pay. Quill walks. The lamp stays lit. That is the whole bargain.
Lamp out in the nave means turn around. You are already behind.
rook: Last stall with a fire. Past me, the stair does not care who you killed.
Buy here. I am not carrying a counter up those steps.
The rift stone stays dark until Mael is quiet. I don't bargain with rocks.
ive: The steps are already named. Leave yours in your mouth.
I can give the points back. I cannot give you the step you fell from.
nell: Quill can climb. Bring the lamp down. Bring Quill, if the stair allows.
Someone has to keep this door warm. It will be me.

1.cinder_warden: Wardens want the heavy mail. I sell what fits. Your back does the rest.
1.reed_caller: A bow in a kiln town. Fine. The arrows are with the cord.
1.briar_stalker: You look ready to leave. Pay before you do.
1.salt_reaver: That edge is already thirsty. I take coin, not blood.
1.bell_chanter: If the bell is the weapon, the staff is for walking. I sell both.

2.cinder_warden: Nets and oil. Leave the wrapped bronze where it hangs.
2.reed_caller: You will want the still water. It is a tool. It is not kin.
2.briar_stalker: I can see you deciding to wait. The lurkers had that idea first.
2.salt_reaver: Hit the boots that arrive late. Yours are the early pair.
2.bell_chanter: I mend nets. I do not unwrap bells. Do not ask.

3.cinder_warden: Steel is on the left. You already brought your own brand.
3.reed_caller: Your little glass things hate the sap. So do my boots.
3.briar_stalker: Knife people do well here, until they get curious about the red fruit.
3.salt_reaver: The orchard knights want a long fight. Disappoint them.
3.bell_chanter: Ring the rows, not the market. The moths are listening for an excuse.

4.cinder_warden: Buy the heavy thing here. I am not carrying it up those steps.
4.reed_caller: Arrows, cord, a flask. The stair does not restock anyone.
4.briar_stalker: You can vanish on a road. A named step does not allow it.
4.salt_reaver: Quick is a gift until the stair turns. Then quick is a fall.
4.bell_chanter: Save the low chord for the kiln. This door has heard enough.

quests.name: Nails for the Gate
quests.text: Senn wants six down in the Cinderwood. The belt comes after.
quests.offer: The north road is eating people. Six dead in the Cinderwood. Don't haul them here. The count is enough.
quests.thanks: Six. Take the belt. It counts fairer than I do.

quests.name: Not Your Boots
quests.text: Brin wants six of the copies on the Mirror Flats put down.
quests.offer: Boots on the flats that are not yours. Put six of them down. The wrapped bells are a different job.
quests.waiting: {n} of six. Your own shadow is not one of them.
quests.thanks: The cap rings when you are about to be stupid. Wear it.

quests.name: Before the Market
quests.text: Vetch wants six of the walking rows down before they reach the stall.
quests.offer: The rows are walking into the stall. Six down. The knife is yours. I will not use it on an apple.
quests.waiting: {n}. I can hear the sap from here.
quests.thanks: Point it at what walks. Not at anything red.

quests.name: A Name Off the Stair
quests.text: Rook wants six of the nameless things on the Pale Steps put down.
quests.offer: Something on the steps is collecting names. Six of those. I am not taking this staff up.
quests.waiting: {n} of six. Keep your own name in your pocket.
quests.thanks: The staff still rings. Not at my door.

1.cinder_warden: You smell like the kiln already. Stand in it, not in my light.
1.reed_caller: No still water here. Call what you can out of the slag.
1.briar_stalker: You do not stand where a crowd stands. The wood will suit you.
1.salt_reaver: Quick steel. The salt road is quicker. Buy cord.
1.bell_chanter: Ring it past the arch. Not over my counter.

2.cinder_warden: Your heat cracks glass. Learn which copy is you before you swing.
2.reed_caller: The mere will answer you. A struck bell answers Morra. Not the same courtesy.
2.briar_stalker: The reeds hide your sort, and worse. Do not make me guess.
2.salt_reaver: Fast steel and a mirror is how people cut themselves.
2.bell_chanter: Hum if you must. One true note and the pool sits up.

3.cinder_warden: Brand what walks the rows. The rows themselves grow back.
3.reed_caller: Sap fouls glass. Keep your chorus off the fruit.
3.briar_stalker: These rows were made for waiting. You will feel at home. Do not get hungry.
3.salt_reaver: Cut and move. A row closes if you stop to look at it.
3.bell_chanter: The nave already holds a low note. Add yours on the way out.

4.cinder_warden: The kiln above is the one that taught yours. Do not bow to it.
4.reed_caller: No water on the stair. Call what you brought, and keep climbing.
4.briar_stalker: Nothing up there hides in a bush. You will have to move first.
4.salt_reaver: The steps are narrow for a spin. Save the wide cut for the kiln.
4.bell_chanter: Names come loose if you ring them. Ring Mael. Not the steps.

intro.title: The kiln is still fed
lines: Hearthveil feeds the kiln so the ash will sleep.
It is not sleeping. The north arch is the road.

act2.title: The Glassmere
lines: North of the salt, the water went to glass.
Brinehollow stands on stilts. Brin has the nets.

act3.title: The Night Orchard
lines: The rows walk after dusk. Vesper keeps the lamps hooded.
Vetch has the stall. Sallow is the tree that would not be cut.

act4.title: The Pale Stair
lines: Ashgate is as high as the warm air goes.
Rook sells here, and no farther. Mael is the fire above the names.

act1end.title: The kiln goes quiet
lines: Veyra is down. The heat stayed in the metal.
Brinehollow is open. Ask Brin before you trust the water.

act2end.title: The pool settles
lines: Morra is under the silt. Leave the water to finish that.
The roots kept going. Vesper is next. Buy steel there.

act3end.title: The rows stop
lines: Sallow is still. The market can try the apples again.
Ashgate keeps a door under the pale stair. The fed fire is above it.

finale.title: The ash banks
lines: Mael is down. Nobody has to feed the kiln tonight.
The rift stone is warm if you want a harder road. Or go home and choose the fire.
